title: columellia oblonga subsp. serrata
intro: Columellia oblonga subsp. serrata, commonly known as the South American "Yerba de Pasmo" or "Columbellea", is a plant species within the family Gentianaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, primarily to treat respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its potential health benefits of reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. The therapeutic actions of Columellia oblonga subsp. serrata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including iridoids and gentiopicroside, which have been found to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. However, more research is needed to confirm the full extent of its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
